description: Minimal perturbation contract for conflict-aware memory update.

fields.perturbation_id: Stable id for a perturbation event.
fields.type: relocated, removed, confidence_degraded, relation_changed, or distractor_inserted.
fields.target_label: Target semantic label affected by the perturbation.
fields.old_position: Previous BEV position [x, y], if available.
fields.new_position: New BEV position [x, y], if available.
fields.time: Integer timestamp when perturbation becomes visible.
